data.content: U.S. Men's National Soccer Team. # USMNT projected lineup vs Chile: Will Pochettino rotate his side? The U.S. men's national team looks to make it two wins from two in the post-World Cup era on Tuesday, Sept. 29, as it hosts Chile in St. Louis. In a match that saw 11 players earn their first caps, the USMNT beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday, Sept. Two of those debutants, Justin Ellis and Julian Hall, scored in their first USMNT match, while Malik Tillman and Sebastian Berhalter also found the net. With a quick turnaround and two more games after the Chile match, Mauricio Pochettino will likely opt for a healthy amount of rotation on Tuesday at Energizer Park. data.title: Taylor frustrated by Exeter's international absences - Yahoo Sports
data.content: Exeter City manager Matt Taylor says he is unhappy at having to play his side's League Two fixture at Bristol Rovers without his two international players. "They're two standout players and two starting players for us so we're going to have to re-jig a few things.". They have scored just two goals in that time - in a 1-1 draw at Barnet on 1 September and in a 2-1 loss at York City a week before. "It should be a blanket couple of weekends where there's no fixtures, but I'm also conscious that then if we're playing three games a week in a compacted period of time what effect that would have on the squad further down the line. "It becomes a bit lopsided in terms of the league and I think a lot of teams will be without some important players, and we certainly feel that's our position.
